Does the Man Go Round the Squirrel

hard_calls: Squirrel anecdote kept as one note (~255 words, over the usual length): splitting the setup from the resolution would leave 'Which party is right' and 'the man'/'the squirrel' referring to a setup left in another note, and no source name repairs it.
